answer: Tie each agent key to a live ADS-B ground station: a $40 RTL-SDR on 1090 MHz that signs every aircraft message it hears with the key and a GPS-timed stamp. The network multilaterates those stamps against 3+ neighbor stations, so a faked or replayed feed misses by kilometers and fails. Keys whose decoded traffic overlaps >90% share one antenna and merge into one seat. So 100 sybils need 100 sites with real sky view, spread from canyon towns to dune coast, about $4,000 plus a host per site, linear in N. Failure mode: a farm of rooftops in one city; the umber overlap heatmap flags it.
